verdict.rationale: Open WebUI is a self-hosted AI platform with its own API surface, so an official MCP server exposing it to external agents is a fair question. However, the evidence only shows client-side MCP support: Open WebUI can call tools exposed by external MCP servers. Nothing shows Open WebUI itself running or publishing an MCP server that other agents can connect to, and client-side support does not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
